d: The United Nations is more than 80 years old. It has had nine secretaries-general - and every single one has been a man. Now, the race to choose the next UN chief is underway. Seven candidates are in the running, including women who could make history. But there is a major roadblock: the UN Security Council’s veto system. Could a new candidate enter the race? And will the world finally see a woman lead the United Nations? Palki Sharma tells you.
